label: Round Pocket
description: A round chest pocket is a patch pocket with curved, rounded bottom corners sewn to the left breast. The softened corners make it the most common and versatile pocket shape, reading as classic and unobtrusive. It adds a touch of casual practicality without disrupting the shirt's overall clean lines.
